hero.title: About EcoReport
hero.subtitle: AI-powered campus energy waste reporting and reward platform

tagline.quote: One photo of lights on in an empty classroom → AI analysis → points earned
tagline.description: Small student reports reduce campus electricity bills, and part of those savings flows back to students.

overview.title: Project Overview
overview.description: EcoReport is a crowdsourcing platform where students report invisible campus energy waste via smartphone, AI automatically detects waste and calculates savings, and verified reports earn points.

items.tech: AI image analysis · Savings calculation · Point settlement

report.title: Photo Report
report.description: Students upload photos of waste in empty classrooms.

ai.title: AI Analysis
ai.description: AI detects waste and calculates savings in money and kWh.

cycle.title: Virtuous Cycle
cycle.description: Part of saved electricity costs returns to the student reward pool.

whyUniversity.title: Why Start with Universities?
whyUniversity.summary: Universities are the first market that simultaneously satisfies three conditions: serious waste, student participation, and cultural diffusion.

management.title: Management Gaps
management.description: Club rooms and seminar rooms are hard to monitor — student reports fill the gap.

physical.title: Patrol Limits
physical.description: Tall buildings, hills, stairs, and no elevators make full patrol coverage difficult.

culture.title: Cultural Diffusion
culture.description: A starting point where eco-friendly habits learned on campus spread to society after graduation.

culturalDiffusion.title: Cultural Diffusion — Starting in the Classroom
culturalDiffusion.lead: Universities are educational spaces where students learn about the environment and sustainability.
culturalDiffusion.body: The experience that "my actions create change" on campus becomes the seed of eco-friendly culture that spreads to workplaces and communities after graduation. EcoReport is not just a tool to save electricity — it is a platform for student-led carbon-neutral culture.

points.experience: Shift from passive environmental awareness to active participation through "my photo changes the campus"
points.education: Natural alignment with green campus campaigns and the Ministry of Education's Green Smart Future School initiative
points.expansion: Low-cost, immediately deployable model expandable from universities to public institutions and offices

team.title: Team 14

cta.title: Join Us Today
cta.description: Small actions across campus add up to big change.
